QuestInfo.name: Attempting the M-Forcer Action Exam
QuestInfo.0: Anyone can take the M-Forcer Action Exam of they have courage, will, and faith! Talk to Dr. Kim and see what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: To participate in the M-Forcer Action Exam, earn as much courage, will, and faith as you can by #bMM/DD/YYYY (Day) HH:MM AM/PM UTC#k, then click on the Quest Notifier to the left to attempt the exam. Collect courage, will, and faith by #reliminating monsters.#k
QuestInfo.2: To participate in the M-Forcer Action Exam, earn as much courage, will, and faith as you can by #bMM/DD/YYYY (Day) HH:MM AM/PM UTC#k, then click on the Quest Notifier to the left to attempt the exam. Collect courage, will, and faith by #reliminating monsters.#k

0.0: I'm sick of building robots! Why won't anyone let me build a tree for once? Or a garden? Oh, you must be here because of the M-Forcer recruitment. Time for the old spiel... Anyone with enough #bcourage, will, and faith#K can become an M-Forcer, blah blah blah. Interested?

no.0: Well, I'm not interested in building machines, either, but we can't all get what we want, can we?

yes.0: To obtain #bcourage, will, and faith,#K you just have to hunt monsters. Any monsters #rbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k will do. Of course, don't you think your time would be better spent planting flowers?
yes.1: Besides courage, will, and faith, you'll also need high points in your Trust of the People Score, Bonus Score, and Interview Score.
yes.2: Your Trust of the People score is based on your level, class, fame, and appearance. #bTalk to Dr. Pepper#k for advice on how to improve your #bGood Impressions Score#k
yes.3: Your Bonus Score is based on how much extra courage, will, and faith you can build. A Bonus Score isn't mandatory, but it certainly helps.
yes.4: You can obtain higher quality courage, will, and faith by hunting monsters in Mu Lung Dojo and Gonzo Gallery, by eliminating master monsters, and by completing party quests. You'll want to #bconfer with General Maestro.#k
yes.5: Your Interview Score will be based on conversations between you and, well, me. I'll ask questions about becoming an M-Forcer, and you'll answer. You'll do well if I think you make a good fit.
yes.6: To become an M-Forcer, you'll need a combined Trust of the People Score, Bonus Score, and Interview Score of at least 1,000. You may keep trying if you don't pass. You can retry even if you do well.
yes.7: Well, that certainly dragged on. I would've much preferred soaking in the sunshine, but no one gets everything they want. If you need more info, read my books. Now, excuse me while I finish building this wretched robot.
